circuits.name: Silverstone
circuits.description: Fast, linked corners. Aero load and tyre energy dominate.
circuits.surface: High lateral tyre loads; C1–C3 allocation. Qualifying followed changing conditions.

circuits.name: Monza
circuits.description: Long full-throttle runs punctuated by heavy braking.
circuits.surface: Resurfaced for 2024. Low wing and braking stability compete; C3–C5 allocation.

circuits.name: Monaco
circuits.description: Low-speed direction changes. Mechanical grip and traction matter.
circuits.surface: Smooth road asphalt and low tyre energy. High aero configuration; C3–C5 allocation.

circuits.name: Bahrain
circuits.description: Stop–start traction zones and a demanding abrasive surface.
circuits.surface: Abrasive asphalt, rear-tyre demand and heavy braking. C1–C3 allocation.

provenance.geometry: OpenF1 approximate locations; MultiViewer turn annotations checked against FIA maps
provenance.split: First two eligible soft flying laps per driver/circuit used for calibration; later eligible soft laps held out. Full timing sectors, no pit-out laps, within 3.5% of that driver’s fastest timed lap. Selection threshold uses session outcomes; fits do not use held-out values.
provenance.limits: No race-control deletion/flag filtering, unknown fuel/SoC and changing track grip. Silverstone Pérez had no soft samples and is excluded from fit/validation. Distance normalized to FIA lap length; timestamp/position feeds approximate.
